tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background and the default ground for everything.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and quiet input borders on paper. Decorative only; not for borders that carry meaning (use ink).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on paper (17.9:1), leaf-soft (14.8:1), highlight (16.3:1) and leaf (5.8:1). Also the bold block colour and the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on paper (6.9:1), leaf-soft (5.7:1) and highlight (6.3:1).

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: The brand green (Grass): primary buttons, big colour blocks, and icons or borders that carry meaning on paper (3.1:1). Not for text on paper; use leaf-ink. On ink it works as text or marks (5.8:1).

tokens.name: on-leaf
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a leaf fill (5.8:1).

tokens.name: leaf-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: links and positive values on paper (5.6:1), leaf-soft (4.6:1) and highlight (5.1:1).

tokens.name: leaf-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted panels, selected rows and tag backgrounds behind ink or leaf-ink text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Pale marker yellow, always behind ink text (16.3:1): a marker stroke under a word or two, the leading row of a table, a sticker on an ink block. Never text, and never a block on paper by itself (1.1:1, it disappears). One per screen.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions; as text on paper (5.0:1). Always paired with a word or icon. Orange so it never relies on a green/red difference.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags and eyebrows, set in capitals.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control padding, card padding on small screens, stack gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding, section gutters and the gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and toggles: always fully round.
